video_title: How WWE LEGEND Ric Flair SURVIVED a plane crash

quotes.speaker: Ric Flair
quotes.summary_phrase: Ric Flair recounts surviving a plane crash that killed the pilot
quotes.excerpt: killed the pilot and paralyzed two other guys
quotes.quote: It killed the pilot and paralyzed two other guys. I survived, yes sir, thank God.

quotes.speaker: Ric Flair
quotes.summary_phrase: Ric Flair discusses his near-death experience from a lightning strike
quotes.excerpt: I almost died five years ago, nine years ago. Five percent chance to live.
quotes.quote: I almost died five years ago, nine years ago. Five percent chance to live. Life support for 14 days, then I had to wear what's called a stoma, a bag attached to my intestine for a year and a half. That's a long time for me to go without drinking.

quotes.speaker: Ric Flair
quotes.summary_phrase: Ric Flair on his enduring energy and physical resilience at 77
quotes.excerpt: I just turned 77 and I feel like I'm 35. I don't have any aches or pains.
quotes.quote: I just turned 77 and I feel like I'm 35. I don't have any aches or pains. I tore my rotator cuffs four times, but they don't hurt. I can't bend them, but they don't hurt. No knees, no hips. All my friends, every one of them that's still alive, they have knee replacements, hip replacements, shoulder replacements. Hell, Hulk had 11 back operations. Hulk was in bad shape when he passed away.

quotes.speaker: Ric Flair
quotes.summary_phrase: Ric Flair on the physical toll of professional wrestling
quotes.excerpt: we had five guys with broken necks in the last two years.
quotes.quote: We had five guys with broken necks in the last two years. Not paralyzed, but were broken necks at the end of their career.

quotes.speaker: Ric Flair
quotes.summary_phrase: Ric Flair reflects on his grueling travel schedule during his prime
quotes.excerpt: I had weeks where I wrestled Ricky Steamboat nine hour Broadways, twice on Sunday and twice on Saturday.
quotes.quote: I had weeks where I wrestled Ricky Steamboat nine hour Broadways, twice on Sunday and twice on Saturday. Four hours in a weekend.

quotes.speaker: Ric Flair
quotes.summary_phrase: Ric Flair on the greatness of Sting as a wrestler
quotes.excerpt: He had a phenomenal look, great physique, nice guy, good attitude.
quotes.quote: He had a phenomenal look, great physique, nice guy, good attitude. His first big match was with me for an hour. We went up against WrestleMania at the first Clash of Champions. And going an hour, if you haven't done it before, it's a long time because you got to pace yourself. He did it. So, we've been great friends for years.

quotes.speaker: Ric Flair
quotes.summary_phrase: Ric Flair praises the athletic background of Wilt Chamberlain
quotes.excerpt: I met Wilt Chamberlain. Brother, he was something to meet, I'm not kidding you.
quotes.quote: I met Wilt Chamberlain. Brother, he was something to meet, I'm not kidding you. If you look at his athletic background at the University of Kansas, second to anything I've ever seen. I got in a big argument with Stephen A. over Wilt because he said Russell owned him. I don't know, Russell, the Celtics owned him, but he was a man I have. 7'2", 320 pounds. He was loving to play beach volleyball.

quotes.speaker: Ric Flair
quotes.summary_phrase: Ric Flair calls Shawn Michaels the greatest worker ever
quotes.excerpt: He's the greatest worker that ever lived.
quotes.quote: He's the greatest worker that ever lived. And you know why? What makes him great is he can be a prick, but he also can be a good guy. He's got that in him to make you mad, but he's also got that in him to make you love him.

quotes.speaker: Ric Flair
quotes.summary_phrase: Ric Flair on receiving a $100,000 Rolex watch from Shawn Michaels
quotes.excerpt: He handed me a $100,000 Rolex watch.
quotes.quote: He handed me a $100,000 Rolex watch. It said 24 on it, all diamonds at the band and everything. I got on the plane the next day and a guy said, are you a Jeff Gordon fan? I said, look pal, we just had WrestleMania in Orlando. Jeff Gordon.
